_meta.description: Room-specific material/color corrections layered on top of materials_matrix.json's persona palette. materials_matrix.json is persona-only (same finishes regardless of room), which is wrong for balcony (needs weatherproof materials, not indoor lacquer/wool) and studio (needs a livelier zone-marking accent since one flat palette across a multi-function room works against zone separation).

balcony.override_note: Balcony is a weather-exposed space — indoor finishes (lacquer, veneer, wool/bouclé) don't hold up outdoors. Keep the persona's color family, swap the material vocabulary for weatherproof equivalents.
balcony.primary_material_override: Weatherproof powder-coated aluminum, sealed teak, or all-weather woven resin — not interior lacquer or wood veneer.
balcony.textile_override: UV-stable, water-resistant outdoor-grade fabric (solution-dyed acrylic or equivalent) in the persona's tonal family — not indoor wool or bouclé.
balcony.hardware_override: Marine-grade or powder-coated stainless hardware, rust- and salt-resistant.

studio.zone_note: A studio holds a sleep zone and an activity zone in one room. Keep the shared base palette across both, but apply the zone accent color decisively to ONE zone only — typically the desk/activity side — so the two zones read as visually distinct without breaking material cohesion. This does more to separate the zones than any physical divider alone.
